entities.name: Philip Yorke, 1st Earl of Hardwicke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philip Yorke, 1st Earl of Hardwicke, was an English lawyer and politician who served as Lord High Chancellor of Great Britain. He was a close confidant of the Duke of Newcastle, Prime Minister between 1754 and 1756 and 1757 until 1762.
